messages:
Priya Raman: FYI — Sales queued a high-priority ask from HorizonPay: they see a +3x p99 after Friday's infra patch and want a remediation timeline. They asked to move this into next sprint if it's a product regression.
Jake Marshall: Got details from Sam on the support ticket. repro payload is a long chat (avg tokens ~1200) hitting dedicated pools. They say it started after 2026-03-12 deploy.
Samir Patel: attaching the core support notes and header they sent: `customer_id=HORIZON-78, model=redwood-13b-q4, region=us-west-2, dedicated_pool=dp-03`. They included a small trace snippet.
Nina Soto: @Priya can you confirm if Horizon was on a pinned model version? We need to know if routing fallback could have changed.
Priya Raman: They were pinned to 2026-03-09-rc2. Sales says they didn't change anything on their side.
Elena Voss: quick check: last week we rolled kernel selector tweaks on 2026-03-12 that changed fusion heuristics for sequence lengths >1024. Could be related.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-12T04:12UTC - kernel-selector v2.14 applied to serving clusters (note: opt-in for dedicated pools was toggled).
Jake Marshall: Customer reports p50 fine, p95/p99 spike and a lot of queued requests that end up throttled. Sounds like a batching/inflight ratio issue.
Nina Soto: Repro steps requested. Sam, can you ask for a minimal transcript that reproduces the large KV cache and long attention run? If they can share obfuscated transcript + request rate that helps.
Samir Patel: On it. Asking for: sample requests, exact timestamps of errors, whether they saw 429s or just latency. Also clarifying whether this only affects their dedicated pool.
Priya Raman: Product question: If this is caused by kernel selector for long sequences, scope options: 1) hotfix revert to previous kernel selector (safety-first), 2) targeted patch to batching heuristics, 3) customer-side mitigation doc (prompt chunking + rate limits). Which should we prioritize?
Elena Voss: From infra POV, hotfix revert is fastest to reduce risk for customers pinned to older versions. Patch will take a few days to validate. Docs are short-term.
Nina Soto: For prioritization, we need impact metrics: how many customers on pinned variants might hit this. @Priya can you ask Sales to run a quick query for other customers using the same model + dedicated pools?
Priya Raman: Will coordinate — asking Sales to include counts and revenue bucket. Horizon is enterprise, high revenue.
Jake Marshall: Also add acceptance criteria if this goes to product backlog: A) reproduce in staging within 48h B) p99 reduced to baseline on dedicated test pool C) rollback plan and automated monitor to detect recurrence.
Samir Patel: Filing intake card now with those ACs. Ticket: PROD-INTAKE-5432 (includes customer logs, deploy tags, ask from Horizon to be notified).
Priya Raman: Thanks. Tentative plan: 24h triage (SRE + infra reproduce), if repro confirmed => hotfix revert + patch investigation; if not repro => keep in backlog but provide mitigation doc to Horizon.
Nina Soto: I'll own the SRE reproduce. Jake can you own telemetry query for other affected customers?
Jake Marshall: Yep. Sending a query to analytics and will post results in this thread.
Samir Patel: Noted — I'll keep the customer updated with ETA for a 24h investigation.
Elena Voss: Adding a gating note for release team: please pause rollout of kernel-selector v2.14 to remaining dedicated pools until we triage.
Priya Raman: Agreed. Priority: P1 for Horizon for now. If telemetry shows broader impact escalate to cross-cutting incident.
Jake Marshall: Query results: 4 other dedicated customers have similar usage patterns; 1 in high-rev bucket. Posting a short table in support ticket.
Nina Soto: Repro achieved in staging with same deploy tag. Root cause points to fusion heuristic + large batch formation for long sequences causing head-of-line blocking.
Priya Raman: OK — decision: hotfix revert rolled to dedicated pools serving enterprise customers, patch dev starts immediately. Sam, let Sales know and request acceptance criteria from Horizon for validation.
Samir Patel: Will update Horizon: we are rolling a targeted revert for enterprise pools; we'll follow up when patch is ready for validation.
Priya Raman: Thanks team. Closing loop: add item to roadmap board under "serving reliability" with link to PROD-INTAKE-5432 and ACs Jake listed. Also add customer-visible remediation notes to KB. :white_check_mark:
